Farmers from Batangas held a protest action at Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila today, April 10. 

Kaisahan ng Manggagawang Bukid Secretary General Guillermo Hernandez said they are calling for aid for farmers amid the ongoing energy crisis. They are also pushing for the removal of Value-Added Tax (VAT) on petroleum products and for the government to repeal the Oil Deregulation Law.

Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste also attended the protest. He expressed support for his constituents’ call to reduce fuel taxes. | via Darlene Cay/GMA News

Visit https://t.co/bAMF9JOAN0 for more updates.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Posibleng makaranas ang mga motorista ng pagbagal ng trapiko sa ilang kalsada sa Metro Manila simula ngayong Biyernes, April 10 hanggang Lunes, April 13, mula sa 11 p.m. hanggang 4 a.m., ayon sa Department of Transportation (DOTr).

Dulot ito ng transportasyon ng isa sa Metro Manila Subway Project’s (MMSP) Tunnel Boring Machines (TBM) mula sa Manila Harbor Center patungo sa Tandang Sora Station.

📸: DOTr/ Facebook
